notes.title: 2019 World Cross PvP Season End & Preseason
notes.content:
Greetings, Pioneers!

We would like to announce an official end of World Cross PvP season and share the details about the preseason and season rewards. 



[b]1. 2019 Season End[/b]
 
2019 World Cross PvP Season will end.
Upon the end of season, all 2019 World Cross PvP data will be reset.



[b]2. 2019 Season Rewards[/b]
 
New costumes for Sergeant Barrol and Charlotte will be added to the game and we have prepared gifts for the Families as a token of appreciation of participation in 2019 World Cross PvP. 
 


[b]3. 2020 Preseason[/b]
 
2020 World Cross PvP Preseason will begin and last for 3 months.

  - Match result, Pts, Rankings, and Title records for the preseason will be deleted
    upon 2020 Season Opening. 
  - Balance adjustments and new systems will be updated during the preseason.

[url=http://www.granadoespada.com/page/newsview.php?n=244]Visit here for more details.[/url]



We will do our best to make World Cross PvP pleasurable and exciting more than ever.
Please feel free to share your opinions and suggestion.

Thank you.

notes.title: Regarding the Temporarily Restricted Accounts
notes.content:
Greetings, Pioneers.

 
As you are already aware, we have recently made investigations and took actions against the exploit of international exchange rate on our Steam store. This incident had the potential to leave a gravely negative impact on our in-game market, so we could not help but temporarily restrict many accounts that had not been directly involved in the exploit of the recent issue on the following basis:

 
1. Players who displayed a similar connection pattern to those who have abused the exchange rate (e.g. varying connection IP’s, shared accounts…etc.)

2. Players who have received in-game currencies without having made the exchange with items of equal worth or received items or currencies from suspected accounts.

 
Having conducted an extensive investigation with regards to the issue, we will be releasing the accounts that have been temporarily put on hold due to the above stated reasons. We offer our sincerest apologies for having taken up your valuable time due to our investigation into the matter.


The accounts temporarily restricted will be released by the time this announcement has been posted and we will be issuing compensations for the time we have took in the investigation of the Steam store exploit for all affected players. The compensations can be retrieved by interacting with the Leonardo Expreso NPC in the game.

 

Once again, we would like to apologize and thank you for the patience and understanding you have shown us during this time.

- Interact with NPC Violet in Cite de Reboldoeux to receive Violet’s Weapon Voucher and Hammer.
- Select a Grade 33 Old Weapon.

2) Collect Growth Boosters.
- Complete a daily quest or hunt monsters to collect Growth Booster items.
- To complete a daily quest, you will need to achieve at least 8 mission points.
- You can also choose to hunt monsters, which have a chance to drop Growth Booster items.
- Completing one quest will earn you the following rewards:

Event Enchant Chip Veteran x10
Event Enchant Chip Expert x3
Growth Booster x25
Karin’s Special Certificate x1

3) Enhance your weapon.
- Interact with Violet again and use the Growth Boosters to enhance your weapon.

4) Exchange your final weapon.
- After you’ve enhanced your weapon to the desired Grade, exchange it for your final weapon at NPC Violet.
- Exchanging the final weapon will consume the Hammer and produce an additional Voucher.
 
Important

- Old Weapons obtained from this event cannot be enchanted, enhanced or added sockets. This is only possible in the final weapons you exchange.
- Incomplete event weapons will be automatically deleted at the end of the event period.

notes.title: Granado Espada - North America Servers Coming in May!
notes.content:
Hello,
imcGAMES here.

We are happy to announce that we are currently preparing to open a North America Server for Granado Espada on the Steam platform for players from the US and Canada. 

Link: http://store.steampowered.com/app/663090

We have also updated the name of our service from 'Granado Espada for SEA' to 'Granado Espada' and our EULA in accordance with such changes.

You may wish to refer to Article V of our EULA[http://www.granadoespada.com/page/eula.php] to check if you are playing from a nation under our service. 

Please understand that we may not be able to provide assistance if your nation is not listed under Article V.

[h1][Granado Espada - North America Server Launch Roadmap][/h1]
[b]▶ North America Server Founder’s Pack Sale: AVAILABLE NOW
▶ North America Server Founder's Server Open: May 9th, 2018
▶ Free-to-play: May 16th, 2018[/b]

[h1][Granado Espada - North America Server Launch FAQ][/h1]
[b]Q. What is the launch schedule like?[/b]

A. The North America Servers will kick off by opening our Founder’s servers on May 9th, 2018 offering 7 days of exclusive access to 'Founder’s Pack DLC’ purchasers. The servers will allow access to everyone (Free-to-play) exactly one week later on May 16th, 2018.

The 'Founder's Pack DLC' products will be available on the Steam Store from May 2nd, 2018. However, please note that you will not be able to access the servers before May 9th, 2018 even if you purchase the 'Founder's Pack DLC'.

[b]Q. How do you access the Founder’s Servers?[/b]

A. Players that have purchased ‘Founder’s Pack DLC’ products will be able to access the Founder’s Server from May 9th, 2018 and create their families & characters.

As mentioned before, please note that you will NOT be able to access the servers before May 9th, 2018 even if you have purchased a ‘Founder’s Pack DLC’ product.


[b]Q. What will happen to the game data from the Founder’s Server after the game transitions to Free-to-play on May 16th, 2018?[/b]

A. All data from the Exclusive Access period offered to ‘Founder's Pack DLC’ purchasers will be maintained even when the game becomes totally Free-to-Play. Players that join the game after May 16th, 2018 will be joining the existing server. In other words, the Founder’s Server will become a normal GE server allowing everyone to enjoy the game together.

[b]Q. What is a ‘Founder’s Pack DLC’ product?[/b]

A. The 'Founder's Pack' is a DLC product that will be available on the Steam Store from May 2nd, 2018. Its main benefit will be ‘7 days of Exclusive Access’ which will allow you to gain a head-start. It will be available on the Steam Store in two variants; 'Light' & 'Premium'.

[b]Q. Is there anything else to know about ‘Founder’s Pack DLC’ product purchases?[/b]

A. You will only be able to purchase a maximum of one ‘Founder’s Pack’ variant per account. For instance, you will be able to purchase one Light & Premium product if you wish to do so, but you will not be able to purchase two Light products. Also, please note that NONE of the products are tradable. The ‘Exclusive Access’ authority will be automatically granted to your account if you have ownership of the product.

The North America Server Founder's Pack DLC products can ONLY be retrieved and used on the North America Server. In other words, you CANNOT use them on the existing FERRUCCIO server.

All other ‘Founder’s Pack DLC’ product benefits must be obtained in-game from the “Leonardo Expreso NPC” or the “Get Cash Item” UI. Please make sure to check the NPC or UI to gain your benefits!

We will be making additional announcements regarding the sale of 'Founder's Pack DLC' products on the Steam Store Page, so please keep a close eye on our Official Website!

[b]Q. Where will the server be located? Can I test my connection to the servers?[/b]

A. The server will be located on the East Coast of the US (Virginia). We will be providing a way to test your ping closer to launch, so please keep a close eye on our Official Website!

Thank you.
IMCGAMES

[h1]MAINTENANCE PERIOD[/h1]
[b]- [SGT] 13:00 to 15:30 (March 21, 2018)[/b]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[u][b]1. EVENTS[/b][/u]
[b]- NEW! Gabriella’s Pioneer Support Event[/b]
    - This event is open from the scheduled maintenance on March 21 to May 23, 2018.
    - Details about the event will be announced soon through our News page!

[b]- Lyndon Box now available for purchase![/b]
    - The Lyndon Box will be available at the in-game Cash Shop from March 21 to April 4.
    - You can check details about the box and how to purchase it at the corresponding announcement (to be released at our official website soon)!

[u][b]3. CONTENT CHANGES / ADDITIONS[/b][/u]
[b]- New Character[/b]
    - Doom Slave

[b]- New Quest[/b]
    - Selene Recruitment Quest

- The ‘Snowfield of the Ice Wizard’ quest will now appear automatically to Families who have completed ‘The Power From an Unknown World’.

- 8 New Raid Monsters
  - Distorted Time: Imperium Rex region.

- 8 New Costume Data

[b]- Items[/b]
- Sacred Character Card Box / Ferrucio Character Card Box
- Not included: Selene
    - Included: Lady Rachel, Crusader Daria, Rubiana, Lada, Mediator Berthe, Enforcer Anies.

  - Soul of Castilla
    - Added to ‘Castilla, Relic: Hard’ mission roulette rewards

- Messenger of the Star Earring
    - Item is now sealable.
    - You can now drag and drop ‘+9 Messenger of the Star Earring’ or ‘+10 Messenger of the Star Earring’ items at the ‘Aclla the Fire Shaman’ NPC to trade them for a ‘Messenger of the Star Earring Box’.

- ‘Recipe - Secret Tower - Magic Scroll’
    - Shop price changed to 1,375 Vis.

[b]- Game Options[/b]
    - NEW Show Quest Monster option
    - This option will be turned ON by default. To turn it OFF, go to Game Options (Alt+O) → UI Options and uncheck ‘Show Quest Monster’.
    -  Leave this option activated to highlight quest monsters in yellow (only applies to quests registered in the Quest info window).

[b]- Colony War[/b]
    - Valkyries Crasher’, ‘Valkyries Repair’
     - Now apply a fixed amount of damage to siege skills.
     - Can now be summoned for 60 seconds.
     - Will now disappear if the summoning family becomes incapable of combat (excludes ‘Valkyries Crasher [Trebuchet]’).
     - ‘Valkyries Crasher’ will no longer incorrectly restore HP under certain conditions.
     -  ‘Valkyries Repair’ will now correctly display the amount of HP recovered as intended.

[b]- ‘Faction Colony Defense Upgrade’[/b]
    - Reduced Colony Defense Tower max. HP.
    - Changed the damage reduction effects of the [Enhance Colony Defense] buff.
    - Removed ‘Reinstall Colony Defense Tower’ menu.
    - The Colony Defense Tower will now regenerate automatically shortly after it is destroyed.

[b]- ‘Colony Manager’[/b]
    - Increased the size of the ‘Colony Manager’ NPC.
    - Removed ‘Reset Optional Upgrades’ menu.

[u][b]4. BUG FIXES[/b][/u]
[b]- Skills & Stances[/b]
    - Fixed the issue where certain skills would stop responding as intended when used continuously.
    - Corrected the knockback timing of targets hit with skills in the [Corsair] and [Carrier] stances.
    - Fixed the error causing the [Golden Circle Mark] buff to allow for irregular additional damage to enemy characters with low max. SP.
    - (WPVP) ‘Mediator Berthe’ skills will no longer incorrectly deal damage to allies.

[b]- Graphics[/b]
    - Corrected Orden attack graphics in the ‘Remains of Sky Road’ mission.
    - Executing ‘View Character’ will no longer incorrectly display the other player’s character with their pose deactivated.

[b]- Quests, Systems and Other Functions[/b]
    - Fixed the issue where, after receiving a bypass quest, certain future quests became impossible to accept when the first quest was completed by a means other than the bypass mission.
    - Corrected the stats of the Beatrice monster appearing in the ‘L vs Beatrice’ battle of ‘[The Leader of a New Era] Execution’.
    - Scenario quest ‘[Discord] Pair Annihilation’ can now be successfully completed as intended.
    - Quests ‘Misfortune of Cortes’ and ‘Red Rose’s Petal’ can now be active at the same time as intended.
    - ‘Divine Necklace’, ’Divine Belt’ and ‘Divine Earring’ items can now be correctly destroyed at the ‘Anvil for Destruction’ NPC.
    - You can now move to the ‘Twisted Time: Imperium Arma’ region correctly as intended.
    - Corrected location display errors occurring in certain monsters when defeated.
    - The warp gate NPC will now correctly appear in ‘Mission: Imperium Rex’ as intended.
    - Creating a Wizard character will no longer cause connection issues.
    - You can now obtain ‘Montoro’s Energy - Jealous’ from ‘Lucifer Castle, Moonlight Garden: Hard’ as intended.
    - Entering a region with [Clique Battle Title Turf] active will no longer consume the same amount of HP increased.
    - The ‘Tetra Avernus Road’ can now be completed as intended in all circumstances.
    - Corrected occasional application issues with Faction points.

[u][b]5. TEXT FIXES[/b][/u]
- ‘Experimental Arm Shield’
    - Fixed incorrect ‘trial cannon’ reference in tooltip.

- [Demon of the Sea] buff tooltip
    - Added missing specific stat values.

notes.title: [UPDATED] Scheduled Maintenance for February 28, 2018
notes.content:
Hello, imcGAMES here.

We would like to announce the details of the maintenance scheduled for February 28, 2018. Make sure to check below for the schedule and patch notes.

[b][h1]MAINTENANCE PERIOD[/h1][/b]
[b][UPDATED] - [SGT] 13:00 to 16:30 (February 28, 2018)[/b]
 
[b][h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1][/b]
[u][b]1. EVENTS[/b][/u]
[b]- Suspicious Veronif Event Closing[/b]
[b]- NEW! Kranus Inclusion[/b]
- This event is open from the scheduled maintenance on February 28 to March 28, 2018.
- Details about the event will be announced later through our News page.

[u][b]2. CONTENT CHANGES / ADDITIONS[/b][/u]
[b]- New Items[/b]
- 15 NEW Artifacts
- You can craft only one type of Unique Artifact. You can use the ‘Anvil for destruction’ NPC to destroy it and craft again.

[b]- New Quests[/b]
- Quest automatically obtained by families who have completed ‘[Synodia] To Altria...’ when entering the Illisia region.
- After completing the quest, you can obtain one random ‘Image of Emotion’ from the Arpe Valeron NPC. 

[b]- Colony War Changes[/b]
- ‘Faction Colony’
- ‘Faction Colony Guardian’ deleted.
- Basic max. HP of Faction Colony increased.
- Basic attack type of Faction Colony changed to non-property magic attack.
- Basic attack of Faction Colony now selects a random target each time.
- ‘Faction Colony Upgrade’
- All Faction Colony upgrades will now consume Elemental Jewels.
- All Faction Colony upgrades will reset if the Faction Colony is destroyed.
- Regular Upgrade
- Regular upgrades will apply separately from optional ones.
① Max. HP Upgrade
- Increases the max. HP of the Faction Colony with each stage of upgrade.
- ‘Valkyries Crasher’
- Max. HP increase, now takes all attacks as 1 damage.
- Removed summon duration, automatically destroyed when the summoner moves to the Barracks or another map.
- 5 NEW ‘Valkyries Repair’ defensive weapon items
- The new items can be purchased at the Tool Merchant NPC in each city.
- Using once of these items creates a ‘Valkyries Repair’ defensive weapon and repairs the adjacent Colony.
- ‘Valkyrie Destroyer’ removed
- Families who possess this item will receive its corresponding value in Vis at their Cabinets.
- Items stored in the Faction Inventory will be exchanged for Vis and sent to the corresponding Families’ Cabinets.
- Bounty Hunter Guild Changes
- The ‘Token – Bounty Hunter Guild’ item can no longer be traded or discarded.
- ‘Token Merchant – Cash Item’ will change as follows:
- Will no longer sell ‘Pet Food’, ‘Invisible Potion’, ‘Valkyrie Crusher [Grand Master]’, ‘Event Soul Crystal’ or ‘Reinforced Enchant Stabilizer’.
- Name changed to ‘Token Merchant - Weapon’.
- New items added to the shop:

Click to see more details: http://www.granadoespada.com/page/newsview.php?n=77

notes.title: Refining Event of Artisan Victor (Nov 29th)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30886570/3db7757b7254a8d853b390f4cf1edbe572932678.jpg[/img]

Greetings Pioneers, 

The Refining Event of Artisan Victor will start after the Scheduled Maintenance on November 29, 2017, and will be held for four weeks!

Complete daily quests to obtain consumable items and collect quests items to exchange for better rewards!

[b][u]Event Period[/u][/b]
- FROM the scheduled maintenance on November 29, 2017
- TO the scheduled maintenance on December 27, 2017

[b][u]Who Can Participate[/u][/b]
- This event is open to all Families

[b][u]How to Participate[/u][/b]
[b]STEP 1. Complete Daily Quests by taking to Artisan Victor at Cite de Reboldoeux, Officer Street![/b]
- Daily Quest: Obtain 10 Rank Mission Points (Can be done once per day)
- How to obtain Points: Completing Rank Missions will give you the same equivalent of Mission Points
EXAMPLE) 2 Points accumulated for completing a Rank 2 mission

[b]STEP 2. Talk to Artisan Victor after obtaining 10 Rank Mission Points to get the following rewards![/b]
-Enchantment Chip Lv.100 (Event)	* 10
- Enchantment Chip Veteran (Event) * 5
- Training Card G (Event) * 2
- Refined Steel * 2
 
[b]STEP 3. Collect Refined Steel to exchange them for the following rewards![/b]
- Event Strata Devil Weapon Merchant Summon Stone
- Event Evil Weapon Merchant Summon Stone
- Event Constellation Weapon Merchant Summon Stone
- Valeron's powder - 35 grade
- Valeron's powder - 34 grade
- Valeron's powder - 33 grade
- Veteran G EXP Card
For more details, check our Official Website: http://www.granadoespada.com/page/newsview.php?n=47

[b][u]Important[/u][/b]
- Event rewards cannot be traded nor exchanged.
- The Refined Steel Items will be deleted during the Scheduled Maintenance on December 27, 2017.

notes.title: [UPDATED] Announcement regarding certain game system restrictions for new accounts
notes.content:
Hello,
imcGAMES here.
 
In order to prevent payment fraud-related issues from affecting the game, we have adopted [i][b]a trade restriction policy for new accounts[/b][/i].

This means that players who fall under the following categories will have certain restrictions placed on their accounts.
 
[u][b]1. Who[/b][/u]
- Players with Families less than one week(7 days) old (will be able to trade from day 8 after Family creation)
- Players with Families under Family Level [strike]10[/strike]12 (will be able to trade from Family Level [strike]10[/strike]12)
- Will affect all accounts created after November 15th, 2017
 
[u][b]2. Types of restrictions[/b][/u]
- Will not be able to trade (using the market, dropping items, personal trading, personal shops)
[strike]- Will not be able to enhance items
- Will not be able to enchant items
- Will not be able to apply sockets to items[/strike]
 
We humbly ask for your understanding in that there is [i][b]no method of removing these measures prematurely[/b][/i] before you match the above-mentioned criteria as these measures are being implemented in order to combat fraud.
  
Thank you.
imcGAMES

notes.title: Temporary Family name changing service
notes.content:
Hello, 
imcGAMES here.
 
We would firstly like to offer our humble apologies for the Family name creation issues that occurred after the Founder's Server opened on October 25th, 2017.

We, imcGAMES, in an effort to make sure that you weren't left with a strange Family name, made preparations for a way to allow you to make a [b]one-time Family name change request.[/b]

You will be able to apply for the Family name change from the following link [b]from October 31st, 2017 to November 8th, 2017.[/b] Please make sure to read the following articles carefully.

[b][One-time Family name changing service][/b]
Link: http://www.granadoespada.com/page/familyname.php

[b][IMPORTANT] Please read the following articles carefully.[/b]
1. You will be able to apply for a Family name change after it checking for whether it is not being used.
2. Any Family names that have been successfully requested via the above-mentioned process will be applied after successfully restarting the GE client. 
3. You may experience the following issues after changing your Family name, but the issues will be fixed after the earliest Scheduled Maintenance. For instance, issues for any Family names changed before the Scheduled Maintenance on November 1st, 2017 will be fixed during that maintenance. 
- Faction, Group & Friend Lists: Showing your old Family name / being unable to see your Family name etc
- Squads: Being unable to participate in Squads, recurring messages about leaving the Squad when moving to other areas etc
4. You may only apply for the Family name change 1 time. There is no way for you to request another change, so please make sure that you are applying for the Family name that you wish to use.
5. Any Family names that include restricted words or phrases will not be applicable as Family names.
6. Only the following can be used in Family names: English alphabet characters, numbers, '-' and '_'
 
Thank you.
imcGAMES

We are currently aware of the following issues. We will keep you updated on further procedures.

[b]1. The game client(GE Client) suddenly crashing [FIXED][/b]

The issue with the game client(GE Client) crashing has been fixed.

However, you will need to [b]restart your Steam client for the patch to take place.[/b] Restarting your GE game client will not be enough.

[b]2. Being unable to open Gift Box items [FIXED][/b]

We are looking into the issue and will apply the fix as soon as it is finished. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

[b][UPDATE] Please try and re-login to the game if you cannot see your DLC products under the 'Get Cash Item UI'[/b]
 
[b]3. Graphical issues with certain characters [FIXED][/b]
We are aware of and looking into the issue where certain characters will have graphical bugs that prevent them from being properly shown in-game.

[b]4. Being unable to interact with certain Non-Player Characters [FIXED][/b]

We are aware that players are unable to interact with certain NPCs.

[b]5. EXP bonuses being wrongfully applied in certain areas [FIXED][/b]

There is an issue where EXP bonuses are being wrongfully applied in certain areas.

[b]6. Incorrect items requested when expanding Barrack Slot and Personal Shop [FIXED][/b]

We are aware of and looking into the issue where the wrong items are requested upon attempting to expand Barrack Slots and Personal Shop.
 
[b]7. Ustiur Base Camp inaccessible [FIXED][/b]

- We are aware that players are unable to enter Ustiur Base Camp.
- You will need to restart your Steam client in order to apply the corrections made and access the Ustiur Base Camp.

[b]8. [ADDED] Restrictions during Family & Character name selection[/b]

- There was an issue where certain letters or phrases would not allow the name to be used.
- However, please note that Family & Character names that have already been created cannot be changed to any names currently being used.

 
This announcement will continue to be updated.

Our apologies for the inconvenience.

Thank you.
imcGAMES


==========================================================================
Let us know via Support Ticket on our Official Website if you are experiencing other problems. When reporting issues, please be as detailed as possible. Screenshots in-game details and timestamps would be greatly appreciated. The more information we have on a specific issue, the quicker it will be resolved.
